newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's August cement output falls 0.70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's August cement output falls 0.70 pct.

text.p: Peru's cement production fell 0.70 percent in August to 334,380 tonnes, compared with 336,726 tonnes the same month last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said on Friday.
In the first eight months of 1996, cement production rose 0.68 percent to 2.474 million tonnes from 2.457 million tonnes in the same period last year, the ASOCEM report added.
The biggest cement producer in the eight-month period was Cementos Lima, with 1.049 million tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 508,914 tonnes.
-- Andrew Cawthorne, Lima newsroom, 511 221-2134 REUTER AC
